answer: Someone running 189 aliases hence needs 181 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in plume, expire in reef, and sable lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3688 identities would post 4793 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
